svg.text: Casita 120 V wiring as built: shore-only breaker box + TS-30 (120 V, 30 A)
not behind TS-30 → never on inverter
• Neutral and ground stay separate everywhere in the trailer. No green bonding screw/jumper.
• Wagos: lever connectors rated 20–10 AWG (221-6xx size). Strip 11 mm, tug-test.
• Converter + water heater feeds come OFF the WFCO panel; they are fed only from this box.
• 30A: US Breaker C60X1C30 (UL 489). 20A: CHTAIXI C20 (IEC only; UL 489 recommended).
• Cable clamp/gland on every cable entry. Never two wires under one breaker screw.
• Inverter bonds N-G inside (measured 0 V N-G). Add no other N-G bond anywhere.
Shore N → Neutral Wago → 3 whites out. Shore G → Ground Wago → 3 greens out.
Shore hot → Hot Wago → 3 short 10 AWG jumpers → breaker LINE terminals.
